items.prompt: A force in N is u=[2, 1, -1]. The allowed direction is v=[1, 2, 2]. Compute the vector projection of u onto v (three coordinates).
items.solution: u·v=2, v·v=9. Multiply v by 2/9. The residual must be orthogonal to v.
hints: Identify the requested quantity and its units before calculating.

items.prompt: A corridor permits velocity only along v=[2, -1, 0]. Measured velocity u=[-2, 3, 3] m/s includes an unwanted vertical component. Compute its allowed 3D vector projection. The corridor direction need not be a unit vector. Tolerance ±0.001 for numeric fields; follow the stated units.
items.solution: Use p=v(u·v)/(v·v). The vertical projection is zero; reversing v does not change p.
hints: Identify the model, requested quantity and units before calculating.
